_doc: Copy this file to profile/apply_config.json. These are the answers the auto-applier injects into every application form (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, etc.) and email cover letter. Replace every <TODO>. The script refuses to submit any application that still has unresolved <TODO> in a required field.
_review_before_use: Set auto_submit=false the first 1-2 runs. The pipeline will fill forms and screenshot them but NOT click submit. Verify a few preview.png files look right, then flip auto_submit=true.
_per_jd_doc: When true, scripts/send-email.mjs refuses to send any job that lacks tailored_per_jd:true AND a per-job resume_tailored.pdf. Quality > volume.

other_links._doc: Optional. Add any project / library / writing URL you want surfaced in cover letters.

experience_years_by_stack._doc: Optional but useful — some forms ask 'years of React' specifically. Add the stacks you'd answer for honestly.

work_authorization._doc: List every country you might apply in. 'Yes — citizen' / 'Yes — permanent resident' / 'No — would need visa sponsorship' / 'No — would need work permit'.
work_authorization.<TODO: Country>: <TODO: Yes — citizen / No — would need sponsorship>

form_submission_safety._doc: Hard guardrails. The script will refuse to submit if any of these conditions hit.
form_submission_safety.blocked_reason_workday: Workday forms are multi-step custom flows that break too often to auto-submit reliably.
form_submission_safety.blocked_reason_linkedin: LinkedIn Easy Apply violates ToS and risks account ban.
